verdict.rationale: Drata's own API reference documents endpoints for each element of the story: creating custom frameworks and their requirements, creating and modifying controls with requirement mappings, creating custom monitoring tests, and creating evidence library items. The word "Custom" in endpoints like "Create Custom Framework" next to "List Frameworks" implies these sit alongside built-in ones. Missing for 10: any in-app UI documentation or prose describing how custom tests and evidence requirements attach to custom controls, explicit confirmation of coexistence with built-in frameworks, and independent or hands-on corroboration (evidence is endpoint names only).

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones
